osm.per_feature_timestamp: osm_timestamp is object last-edit time, not survey or image date
osm.completeness: Mapped objects only; absence does not imply no road/bridge. Unnamed roads keep null labels. No inferred access roads.

terrain.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
terrain.disclaimer: Historical surface model, edited water surfaces; NOT bathymetry, current terrain or water level. 43.5% of study-boundary source cells are lake edited. Contours are display aids, not survey/engineering contours. No fine-scale drainage or bridge-clearance inference.
terrain.edge_hillshade_nodata: Neutral brightness 180 only at reprojected shade edge; no synthetic elevations.

registration.webmercator_warning: These PNGs are geographic (EPSG:4326), NOT Web Mercator. Use geographic mesh UVs or reproject to EPSG:3857 before mercator image overlays. Do not stretch onto a mercator rectangle without warping.
registration.threejs: Use identical lon/lat-to-scene transform for roads, water, boundary and terrain; x east, z south for north-up. Sample DSM for line draping. Texture image row 0 is north; verify flipY convention.
registration.north_arrow: Geographic north = increasing latitude; rotate with map bearing.
registration.scale_bar: Compute distance with WGS84 geodesic at display latitude; local approximation: longitude metres = dlon*pi/180*6378137*cos(lat), latitude metres ≈ dlat*111210. Do not label degree span as metres.

satellite_status: Handled separately by evidence-content worker; no screenshot or unauthorized commercial tile imagery here.
